answer: The cart stands jacked up in the yard, one wheel off and leaning on the fence. Proof of wheelwright via spoke fit tally — a wheel the wheelwright trues only after 37 wheels hold the road test, each wheel trued by the wheelwright himself. grove fits the spokes first, tapping each one home before the tyre goes on. mirror spins the finished wheel on the axle and watches it run true without a wobble. summit writes the tally in chalk on the cart's side board. To forge this proof a man must true 37 wheels that all run straight, and the thirty-eighth still shudders on the road.
